subject: Piece of Heart
text: Talking to the Skull Kid on the stump to the left in the Lost Woods and playing Saria's Song rewards a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
After entering the Lost Woods, turn 
left and jump on the Stump. Talk to the Skull Kid and then play him "Saria's 
Song". He will give you a piece of heart!

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Playing an ocarina song with the two Skull Kids on the stump down the ladder to the right in the Lost Woods awards a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
After entering the Lost Woods, 
turn right. Head down the ladder and jump on the stump. Play a song with 
the two Skull Kids. Keep up with them and you will get a piece of heart...have a pen and paper ready.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Inside the small shed at the back of Lon Lon Ranch, pulling boxes reveals a crawlspace leading to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Go into Lon Lon Ranch and run to the
back. Go inside the small shed and pull the boxes until you see the 
crawlspace. Enter and recieve the Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Returning a white dog found at night in the back alley to the woman in one of the back alley rooms rewards a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Look for White Dogs in the pack of 
dogs at night (in the back alley). Take it to a woman in one of the rooms 
in the back alley. She will reward you with a piece of a heart for his safe 
return!

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Using the Boomerang or Hookshot allows Link to reach the ledge holding a Heart Piece in the Windmill.

evidence.quote:
Use the Boomerang
or Hookshot to fly up to the ledge containing the Heart Piece in the 
Windmill.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Asking Dampe to dig on soft soil spots during the night Grave Tour can uncover a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
At night, (not Midnight, 
the Grave Tour will be closed) enter the Graveyard and talk to Dampe. Ask
him to dig on the soft soil parts where he walks. Take at least 100 rupees
for insurance. Eventually, you'll find the heart piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Entering the tomb in the middle of the Graveyard, defeating the Zombie, and playing the Sun's Song makes a chest with a heart piece appear.

evidence.quote:
In the middle of the
Graveyard, there is a tomb that has another secret. Fall inside and defeat
the Zombie. Then, play the Sun's Song.  A chest containing a heart piece 
will appear.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Taking the owl's ride from Death Mountain lands Link on a roof in Kakariko Village, where dropping to an awning and entering the door leads to a heart piece beside a cow.

evidence.quote:
talk to the owl. He will give you a 
ride to Kakariko Village, and you'll land on a roof. Use C-Up to look 
around until you see an awning. Drop down and enter the door; the heart 
piece is next to a cow.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Winning in the Bombchu Bowling Game earns Link a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Enter the Bombchu Bowling 
Game. Keep winning until you recieve a piece of heart!

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Lighting a Deku Stick from Darunia's room and lighting the bottom level torches starts the statue spinning, after which throwing a bomb inside from the top yields a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Light a Deku Stick on fire as a
torch in Darunia's room. Run out and light the torches around the 
bottom level of the city. The Statue will start spinning. Run to the 
top and throw a bomb inside, you will recieve a piece of heart!

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Carrying the chicken before the bridge and gliding through the waterfall to the right leads to a secret area containing a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
There is a chicken before the
bridge. Pick it up and fly through the waterfall to your right. There 
is a secret area.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: In the fenced area outside Lake Hylia on Hyrule Field, bombing the upper-right quadrant reveals a hole where defeating a Deku Scrub allows Link to buy a Heart Piece for 10 rupees.

evidence.quote:
In the fenced-in area, throw a bomb in the 
upper-right quadrant. Drop into the hole and defeat the Deku Scrub 
for the chance to buy the Heart Piece for 10 rupees.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Catching a 10 pound or larger fish as child Link in the Fishing Pond awards a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Catch a 10 pound fish or bigger
in the Fishing Pond as a child.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Gliding with a chicken toward the small cliff across the valley opposite the waterfall allows Link to reach a crate containing a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
There
is a crate on a small ledge opposite the waterfall. Grab the chicken
again and jump off the ledge. Force the controller forward and left. 
You need to hit a small cliff on the other side of the valley.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Carrying a chicken up Zora's River, ascending the ladder, and gliding with the second chicken leads to the ledge with the heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Take the Chicken from the beginning of 
Zora's River and travel up the river avoiding the Octoroks...climb the
ladder. Grab the next chicken and use it to fly down to the ledge with
the heart

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Carrying a chicken to the waterfall at the end of Zora's River and ascending the land bridge allows Link to jump to the piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Take the Chicken from the beginning 
and head to the waterfall at the end of Zora's River. Turn around as you 
reach it, and climb up the land bridge nearest to the heart. You can now
jump off the ledge and grab the piece of heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Lighting all the torches in Zora's Domain in rapid succession, including two behind the waterfall, reveals a chest holding a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Torches are located 
around Zora's Domain. Light them quickly starting with the one that is lit 
near the shop...and run into the waterfall, light those two as well. A chest will appear 
giving you another heart piece!

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Playing five upper-row songs for the frogs on Zora's River unlocks a bug-catching game that awards a heart piece upon completion.

evidence.quote:
After playing five of the 
songs on the upper row (Excluding the Song of Storms) on the subscreen,
you will be asked to play a "Bug-Catching" Game. Use the C-Buttons to 
make the frogs jump.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Hookshotting up to the roof near the seated man in Kakariko Village earns a piece of heart as a memento.

evidence.quote:
After getting the hookshot,
head back to the village and shoot up to the roof near the man sitting 
on it. He will give you a piece of heart as a "memento."

subject: Magic Bean
text: Magic Beans can be purchased from the merchant at the start of Zora's River.

evidence.quote:
Buy a Magic Bean
from the "Pig" at the beginning of Zora's River.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Riding the grown magic bean platform as adult Link allows Link to levitate up and smash a box holding a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Come back as an
adult to levitate up. Smash the box and take the Heart Piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Riding the magic bean platform or summoning Pierre to the roof of the Lakeside Laboratory allows Link to climb the ladder to a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
After planting a bean near
the corner of the Lakeside Laboratory, jump on as an adult and ride it
up the the roof. Climb up the ladder and get the heart piece on top!
You can also use Pierre (Scarecrow's Song) here.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping a bug into soft soil before planting a Magic Bean exposes a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Don't forget to put a
bug into the soft soil before you plant so you can defeat a Gold
Skulltula.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the tree stump near the fallen log at Zora's River awards a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the tree stump
near the fallen log upon your journey to the top of Zora's River.
Play the "Song of Storms" to recieve a heart piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Riding the magic bean platform in Death Mountain Crater and hookshotting down enables Link to collect a heart piece on the wall.

evidence.quote:
On the wall
to your right, you can jump on the magic bean "platform" and then 
hookshot down to collect the heart piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Jumping off the magic bean platform into the crater lets Link pick up a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Jump onto 
the Magic Bean "platform" and jump off to the crater to pick up 
the Heart Piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: As adult Link, jumping across ice platforms in frozen Zora's Fountain reaches a heart piece on the right side of the map.

evidence.quote:
After you get past Zora's
Domain as an adult, you'll notice everything is frozen over. Jump
from platform from platform to get the heart piece on the right side
of the map.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Using blue fire on the red ice panel in the fan room melts the red ice block holding a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Use blue fire and open the
other Red Ice panel with the "fan" in it. Use more blue fire to melt
the heart piece stuck inside one of the red ice blocks.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Sinking to the bottom of the center of Zora's Fountain with Iron Boots and the Zora's Tunic yields a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
After you get the Iron
Boots and Zora's Tunic, put them on and drop to the bottom of the 
center of Zora's Fountain. At the bottom is a piece of heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Bombing near the isolated tree to the right of Hyrule Castle reveals a hole where dropping in with Iron Boots lets Link pick up a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
walk near the tree away from the others.
Drop a bomb and fall into the hole. Put on the Iron Boots (you can do
it without the Zora's Tunic) to drop in and pick up the heart piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Diving to the bottom of the dive pool inside the Lakeside Laboratory using the Golden Scale yields a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Use the Golden Scale to dive to
the bottom of the Dive Pool in the Lakeside Laboratory.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Smashing the crate at the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory dive pool with the Iron Boots yields a Skulltula Coin.

evidence.quote:
While you are down there, smash the crate 
with the iron boots and get the Skulltula Coin!

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Racing Dampe inside his tomb after getting the Hookshot and finishing in under 1 minute awards a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Go into Dampe's Tomb
after you receive the Hookshot. Race him again and finish in under 1 
minute to recieve a heart piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Speaking to the person inside the House of Skulltula after gathering 50 Gold Skulltula coins rewards Link with a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Around now you should 
have 50 Gold Skulltula coins. Talk to the person inside and he will
reward you with a heart piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Using the Lens of Truth inside the Treasure Chest Game allows Link to see inside chests and win a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth
and "cheat" in the Treasure Chest Game. You will recieve a Piece of 
Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Reaching the chest on the roof above the jail in Gerudo Fortress with the Longshot or Scarecrow's Song yields a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
When you 
are searching to free the carpenters, look on the roof above the jail
(near there). There is a treasure chest. Fire the Longshot at it and 
find another piece of heart. You can use Pierre with the Hookshot.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Scoring 1,000 points or better on horseback at the Gerudo Fortress Archery Range wins a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Ride her along
the right wall of the fortress and you can go into the Archery Range.
Score 1,000 points or better (it's a cinch) and you win the piece of 
heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Planting a bean near the entrance of the Spirit Temple allows adult Link to ride it up to collect a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Plant a seed into the
ground near the entrance to the Spirit Temple (Use Requiem of Spirit). 
Come back as an adult and fly up to get the piece of heart.

subject: Dampe's Grave Digging Tour
text: The heart piece in Dampe's tour is placed randomly each visit and requires about 100 rupees while digging only on soil.

evidence.quote:
This location is random. It is 
located differently every time you enter. You'll need about 100 rupees
to be certain where the piece is. Only tell him to dig on the soil.

subject: Zora's Domain Torches
text: Lighting the torches requires lighting a Deku Stick at the shop torch, running to the circle of stones torch, relighting the shop torch, relighting the stone torch, and lighting both torches in the waterfall.

evidence.quote:
Start at the torches nearest to the shop,
and run like the wind to go and get the others. You'll eventually overlap. 
Here's what I did...A) Light the Deku Stick. B) Light the torch near the
circle of stones. C) Run back and light the torch near the shop. D) Light
the torch near the circle of stones again. E) Light the torches in the
waterfall.

subject: Ice Cavern Red Ice
text: In the Ice Cavern fan room, melting the opposite red ice wall from the one melted for the Iron Boots exposes the heart piece.

evidence.quote:
You'll have to melt the opposite wall you did when
you were looking for the Iron Boots. (The room with the fan where you melted
the red wall.)

subject: Fishing Pond Big Fish
text: The large fish stays underwater near the big log by the rear lilypads, and using the sinking lure disqualifies the player.

evidence.quote:
You'll have to stand near the lilypads in the rear
of the lake. The big fish usually stays underwater near the big log. You may 
have to catch the little fish that swims with him first. You can not use the 
sinking lure, or you will be disqualified.

subject: Dampe Race
text: When racing Dampe, wear the Goron Tunic, avoid fireballs, hug inside corners, roll frequently, and cross the final crevasse with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
When racing Dampe, make sure you put on 
the Fire Tunic. Don't get hit with the fireballs and always hug the inside 
corners. Roll as much as possible, and at the end, use the Longshot to fly
over the crevasse.

subject: Bomb-Bag Upgrade
text: Keep in mind the Bomb-Bag Upgrade is in here, too.

evidence.quote:
Keep in mind the 
Bomb-Bag Upgrade is in here, too!

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Come back when you are older, step on the plant, and leap off the ledge to get it.

evidence.quote:
Come back when you are older, step on the plant, and leap
off the ledge to get it.
